tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Find ACA Marketplace plans for a household, with the premium tax credit applied and plans ranked by estimated total yearly cost. Also reports the monthly tax credit, cost-sharing reduction (extra-savings Silver) eligibility and likely Medicaid eligibility.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Full details for one plan: deductible, out-of-pocket max, copays, drug tiers, key benefits, and what the person would pay in the plan's official coverage examples (having a baby, managing diabetes, a simple fracture).

tools.name: search_drugs
tools.description: Look up a medication by name (generic or brand) to get its RxCUI, needed by check_coverage. Pick the entry matching the strength and form the person takes.

tools.name: search_doctors
tools.description: Look up a doctor near a ZIP code to get their NPI, needed by check_coverage.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Check whether plans cover specific medications (by RxCUI) and have specific doctors in network (by NPI). Use search_drugs and search_doctors first to get the ids.
